handoff: Layer: game/traffic/traffic_layer.gd (Node3D), created by map.gd as map.traffic, drives itself in _process (zoom fade from map.zoom, clock from main._progress, leg speed from trade.travel_cycles, free ships stepped with game-scaled delta, paused = still). Three global shader uniforms (traffic_clock, traffic_fade, traffic_leg_speed) are set once per frame. One MultiMesh per (group, mesh), each with two surfaces (hull, additive streak): at most 3 groups x 2 meshes x 2 = 12 draw calls. Buffers are rewritten only when a group is set/cleared (dirty flag, flushed once per frame); the free group rewrites only while a ship moves. Instance data lives in INSTANCE_CUSTOM (phase, cargo palette index, state, seed) and the instance transform columns (path: p0, pc, p2; orbit: centre, radii and revs, tilt; free: pos and forward) - read in game/traffic/traffic_motion.gdshaderinc. Proxy meshes (code, ArrayMesh, 2 surfaces): corvette and pirate, about 100 triangles each (Meshes.tri_count). No textures, no imports, assets/ships .import files untouched.

traffic_layer: set_path_group(key, p0, pc, p2, count, state=0 run|1 stalled|2 blocked, cargo: Color, mesh='corvette'|'pirate', scale_mult, speed_mult)
set_orbit_group(key, centre, r_in, r_out, count, mesh, tilt, dir, cargo, scale_mult)
set_free_ship(key, pos: Vector2 xz, target: Vector2, kind, tint, y, scale_mult)  # retarget by calling again
clear_group(key), clear_all(), set_sun_dir(world dir to light), set_view_system(id) (clears all; map.set_view_system calls it)
stats() -> {path, orbit, free, total, draw_calls, fade}, stats_text()
